description: Fine-grained state management for SwiftUI: one app-wide MainActor graph, derived values that recompute only when a dependency changes, and named operations that publish atomic turns.
rules: Declare state as file-scope lets in <Cluster>State+Cogs.swift; keyless names end in Cog and keyed boxes end in Cogs.
Manual sources are private and start with an underscore; expose them through a .readOnly projection that takes the clean name.
Call turn and refresh only inside an extension CogOps named operation; app code, views, and mechanisms call the operation, never the primitive.
Unwrap every read into a domain local on its own line; never bundle reads into a struct or a Cogs helper. Declare a derived value as an automatic cog instead.
Every Cog-using view resolves @Environment(\.cogs) itself; never pass Cogs through a view initializer.

SwiftUI bindings are tracked adapters on Cogs in <Cluster>State+Bindings.swift, with a tracked getter and a setter that calls a named operation; never build a Binding in a view or read the getter with peek.
Assemble Cogs once in the App entry point and write initial state in a Mechanism's operate, not in App.init.
Tests and previews create one isolated Cogs.forTesting() runtime each, drive it through the same operations, and assert with peek.
Run swift package coglint on production sources; the linter enforces these conventions and links each finding to its rule article.
